values.value: Is the applicant's cost per outcome fully loaded, consistent with its own financials, and holding up or improving over time?
1 cost per outcome not known, or not derivable from the applicant's financials
2 a figure is given but not fully loaded, or does not reconcile with the applicant's financials
3 fully loaded and consistent with the applicant's audited financials, latest year only
4 fully loaded and consistent with audited financials, stable or improving over the last three years
5 fully loaded, consistent with audited financials, improving over three years, and independently corroborated
Cost per outcome = total program cost divided by learners placed (RFI Q13 actuals). Judged on the applicant's own reported figure, not against an external benchmark.
Cost per outcome = total program cost divided by jobs created, new and existing businesses (RFI Q17 actuals). Judged on the applicant's own reported figure, not against an external benchmark.

Cost per outcome = total program cost divided by households meeting both income tests (RFI Q22 actuals), computed across the full multi-year support period, since this is an income journey and not a single event. Judged on the applicant's own reported figure, not against an external benchmark.
